P-FROSTLINE.Purpose: Frostline (FLI) connects project intent to codebase implementation via an architectural knowledge graph: a DAG of contract nodes and child-owned in-file parents declarations, delivered to agents as deterministic read-time ancestor context.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Core: lightweight harness-independent deterministic FLI capability.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Runtime: declaration parsing, ancestor Resolution, graph-boundary inference, Discovery, Graph, Context, Delivery.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: Knowledge model: XML contract nodes in tiers Project/System/Subsystem/Module plus a Verification plane.
Scope.SCP-IN-004: Exported Agent skill: frostline-graph. Project-local authoring skills (frostline-verification, frostline-logging) live in `.agents/skills/` and are not part of the distributed product.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Model inference or provider credentials in Core correctness.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Repository-scale semantic construction/repair skills beyond the FLI skill set.

Principles.PRIN-001: Architectural hierarchy: the graph decomposes global intent down to concrete implementation modules (M -> SS -> S -> P).
Principles.PRIN-002: Inheritance without duplication: a statement is anchored at the highest applicable abstraction level; descendants inherit context.
Principles.PRIN-003: Contract-driven authority: contracts are primary; implementation source realizes specified contractual obligations.
Principles.PRIN-004: Graph authority: filesystem plus explicit child-owned parents declarations; derived state is disposable.
Principles.PRIN-005: Actual-read ancestry over speculative relevance search.
Principles.PRIN-006: ancestors(FILE) follows only transitive parents; graph(FILE|DIR) performs one bounded downward discovery, then follows escaping parent edges upward only.
Principles.PRIN-007: Parent Resolution and graph-boundary inference are separate mechanisms.
Principles.PRIN-008: Graph boundary is Core-owned: explicit root -> nearest .frostline/ -> nearest .git/ -> top-level child of HOME; cwd and session identity never define a semantic root.
Principles.PRIN-009: One session may traverse unrelated files/scopes without semantic bleed; HOME itself is never an implicit full-scan region.
Principles.PRIN-010: One statement -> one owning node -> one field -> one FQID address.
Principles.PRIN-011: Model-facing FLI routing uses native skill catalog descriptions only.

Technology.TECH-001: TypeScript is the default implementation language; non-TypeScript code exists only as justified owner-local capability (Codex Rust read classifier).
Technology.TECH-002: Release target: Codex plugin, Linux x86_64; active development target: DeepSeek Harness, Linux x86_64.
Technology.TECH-003: Installed packages are self-contained and offline; no undeclared runtime dependency or development toolchain.
Technology.TECH-004: Deno is the canonical development test runner; reproducibility inputs (lockfiles) are pinned.
